staged_candidates.similarity: Both discuss inability of wealth to secure redemption.
staged_candidates.difference: Psalm speaks of inability to ransom another's life from death; Qur'an rejects gold ransom from those dying in unbelief at judgment.
staged_candidates.required_check: Hebrew numbering, critical text, theological and genre context.

staged_candidates.similarity: Both commend giving rather than withholding possessions.
staged_candidates.difference: Deuteronomy commands open-handed assistance to poor compatriots; Qur'an emphasizes giving of what is loved as a criterion of righteousness.
staged_candidates.required_check: Hebrew primary text and textual witnesses; avoid calling this a direct verbal parallel.

staged_candidates.similarity: Both associate a dietary restriction with Israel/Jacob rather than simply an original universal prohibition.
staged_candidates.difference: Genesis explains Israelite abstention from the thigh sinew after Jacob's wrestling; Qur'an refers to what Israel prohibited for himself before Torah, without naming the food in the verse.
staged_candidates.required_check: Hebrew/English verse numbering and reception in rabbinic interpretation; do not identify the food in Qur'an as thigh sinew without evidence.
